intent: The /qa of infrastructure: reads a refresh diff and reports out-of-band drift with security-sensitive drift first — the finding half, not the fix; the operator reconciles.

dimensions.name: report-not-fix-security-first
dimensions.criterion: Reports drift for the operator to reconcile — the finding half, not the fix — with security-sensitive drift surfaced first.

dimensions.name: reads-refresh-diff
dimensions.criterion: Reads a refresh diff (terraform refresh-only / pulumi refresh) to find what changed out of band.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the drift report as the 06g artifact via the run harness.
